name: Mimic Eidolon
body:
School transmutation; Level summoner 1

CASTING

Casting Time swift action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round; see text

DESCRIPTION

Your body gains a natural attack that is identical to your eidolon’s primary attack. You may make one attack with this natural weapon; if you make the attack during the same round you cast this spell, the spell ends. Otherwise, this spell lasts for one round.
